messages.author: e1aed7f6ccf84b4b
messages.subject: secrlinear and mark-resight models
parts:
Hello,
I am working with a spatial capture-recapture dataset for a stream-dwelling species and am using the secrlinear package to constrain movement to the streams. I would like to use a mark-resight model with sightings only and only including resighted individuals. I have successfully run models without the sighting information but am running into a snag once I try to incorporate the sighting occasions.


I changed the following code to be specific to the sighting only model:

# Add marking occasions - all zeros for 80 occasions to indicate it's a sighting only model 
markocc(Trap) <- rep(0, 80)

# Make capture history
NerCH_S <- make.capthist(captures = NerCapt, traps = Trap)

# Run null model, including linear mask and knownmarks as FALSE to only include resighted individuals
Null <- secr.fit(NerCH_S, mask = streammask,
                 details = list(userdist = distmat,
                                knownmarks = FALSE))


Aside from these lines, the code and preparation is identical to models that ran using secrlinear without sighting data. When I try to run the sighting only model, I receive the following error:

Error in start[parindx[[i]][1]] <- getdefault(names(parindx)[i]) : 
  replacement has length zero

I've done some looking into the function code and other troubleshooting but haven't come up with a solution or understanding of what part isn't working. Any ideas as to how I could get this analysis to work? Let me know if you need any additional information.

Thank you,
-Wendy

I haven't ever thought about mark-resight for linear habitat, but why should it not work? I can't give an instant answer, but will be tempted to look in the next few days. (I like the elegance & efficiency of SECR for linear habitats, but have the opposite feeling about mark-resight).
Murray
